title: Quick Fix Stir Fry
description: A fast and easy stir fry recipe that combines the crunch of vegetables with the nutty flavor of soy sauce.

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Mix (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the Stir Fry Mix and cook until tender.
Add the Soy Sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked Rice to the pan and stir to combine.
Top with Crunchy Peanuts and serve hot.
If using Fix Sauce, drizzle over the top of the dish.
